scope: Synthetic negative-control verification, gold dataset readiness, benchmark observation coverage, and fail-closed calibration harness readiness. No retrieval provider was called.

negative_controls.classification: Injected synthetic controls; not observations from retrieval execution.
negative_controls.positive_control: Clean synthetic observations produce zero security/freshness/partial-outage failures and citation/freshness metrics of 1.0.
negative_controls.release_behavior: Injected failures make the release evaluator FAIL. No threshold or evidence-strength mapping changed.

dataset.source_use: Repository-backed MIT sources validated by pinned SHA-256, canonical line span, and quote hash. All remain development-only; no tenant production data used.
dataset.sampling_and_leakage: Current corpus has no held-out split. Source-group split validator prevents a canonical source from crossing splits. No existing candidate was relabeled or duplicated into held-out.

review_queue.overwrite_behavior: Exclusive create; existing queue files are not overwritten.
review_queue.human_acceptance_semantics: Conflicting or pending human reviews remain pending; human acceptance requires an accepted, resolved review state.

observations.baseline: No development observation baseline exists because no authorized retrieval execution observations were available.

verification.format: PASS: Prettier check for all six changed implementation/test files.
verification.fast_gate: PASS: git diff --check; no conflict markers; task-owned paths only.
verification.independent_review: PASS after repair of conflicting-human-review queue status and addition of case-keyed regression coverage.
verification.lint: NOT RUN: workspace eslint resolved legacy ESLint 6.4.0 with no configuration file in this isolated source tree.
verification.typecheck: NOT RUN: repository policy prohibits local repository-wide typecheck in shared implementation sessions.

implementation.observation_bundle: Backward-compatible named profile bundle validates A-H comparison identity and three separate latency/cost profile identities; certification requires exact complete case coverage for all profiles.
implementation.metric_aggregation: Leakage confidence intervals use observed-case denominators; per-class confidence intervals are unavailable unless observations cover the full class cohort.
implementation.review_queue: Deterministic queue separates human answer review from source/use approval and never upgrades candidate status automatically.

blockers: At least 500 queries still require the canonical human review/adjudication and source-use approval process, with a release-approved held-out cohort.
Authorized retrieval observations are required for all §27 profiles A-H and latency/cost profiles before release criteria can be evaluated.
